REM-SSH-01.objective: Enforce SSHv2 protocol and strong ciphers in Junos
REM-SSH-01.cli_command:
set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh ciphers aes256-gcm@openssh.com aes128-gcm@openssh.com aes256-ctr
set system services ssh macs hmac-sha2-512 hmac-sha2-256
commit comment "Enforce SSHv2 and strong crypto"
REM-SSH-01.before_example: set system services ssh protocol-version v1
REM-SSH-01.after_example:
set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh ciphers aes256-gcm@openssh.com ...
REM-SSH-01.rollback_command:
delete system services ssh ciphers
commit
REM-SSH-01.explanation: Configures Junos SSH daemon to reject v1 negotiations and use authenticated encryption ciphers.

REM-TELNET-01.objective: Deactivate unencrypted Telnet service on Junos
REM-TELNET-01.cli_command:
delete system services telnet
commit comment "Deactivate Telnet service"
REM-TELNET-01.verification_command: show configuration system services | match telnet
REM-TELNET-01.explanation: Removes telnet daemon stanza from system configuration.

REM-HTTP-01.objective: Disable unencrypted HTTP J-Web management on Junos
REM-HTTP-01.cli_command:
delete system services web-management http
set system services web-management https system-generated-certificate
commit comment "Disable HTTP web management"
REM-HTTP-01.rollback_command:
set system services web-management http
commit
REM-HTTP-01.explanation: Deactivates unencrypted web management and binds TLS certificate to HTTPS.

REM-HTTPS-01.objective: Enable HTTPS web management with TLS 1.2+ on Junos
REM-HTTPS-01.cli_command:
set system services web-management https system-generated-certificate
set system services web-management https tls-version 1.2 1.3
commit comment "Enforce HTTPS TLS 1.2+"
REM-HTTPS-01.rollback_command:
delete system services web-management https
commit

REM-SNMP-01.objective: Configure SNMPv3 USM/VACM and purge default communities on Junos
REM-SNMP-01.cli_command:
delete snmp community public
delete snmp community private
set snmp v3 usm local-engine user secadmin authentication-sha authentication-password "AuthPass2026!"
set snmp v3 usm local-engine user secadmin privacy-aes128 privacy-password "PrivPass2026!"
set snmp v3 vacm security-to-group security-model usm security-name secadmin group SECGROUP
set snmp v3 vacm access group SECGROUP default-context-prefix model usm level privacy read-view all-view
commit comment "Configure SNMPv3 authPriv"
REM-SNMP-01.before_example: set snmp community public authorization read-only
REM-SNMP-01.after_example: set snmp v3 usm local-engine user secadmin ...
REM-SNMP-01.explanation: Purges plaintext communities and creates SNMPv3 USM user with SHA auth and AES privacy.

REM-LOG-01.objective: Configure remote syslog logging on Junos
REM-LOG-01.cli_command:
set system syslog host 10.100.20.50 any notice
set system syslog host 10.100.20.50 authorization info
set system syslog time-format millisecond
commit comment "Configure remote syslog server"
REM-LOG-01.before_example: set system syslog file messages any notice
REM-LOG-01.after_example:
set system syslog host 10.100.20.50 any notice
set system syslog time-format millisecond
REM-LOG-01.explanation: Streams notice and authorization events to central SIEM.

REM-NTP-01.objective: Configure redundant NTP time servers on Junos
REM-NTP-01.cli_command:
set system ntp server 10.100.10.10 prefer
set system ntp server 10.100.10.11
commit comment "Configure NTP time sync"
REM-NTP-01.explanation: Binds authoritative time sources to local Junos daemon.

REM-AAA-01.objective: Configure TACACS+ authentication order on Junos
REM-AAA-01.cli_command:
set system tacplus-server 10.100.30.15 secret "C1ph3rX!S3cur3K3y"
set system tacplus-server 10.100.30.15 timeout 5
set system authentication-order [ tacplus password ]
commit comment "Enforce TACACS+ authentication"
REM-AAA-01.explanation: Prioritizes centralized TACACS+ identity verification with local root fallback.

REM-PASS-01.objective: Enforce 15-character minimum password length and SHA-512 hashing on Junos
REM-PASS-01.cli_command:
set system login password minimum-length 15
set system login password format sha-512
set system login password change-frequency 90
commit comment "Enforce 15 char minimum password length"
REM-PASS-01.after_example:
set system login password minimum-length 15
set system login password format sha-512
REM-PASS-01.rollback_command:
delete system login password minimum-length
commit
REM-PASS-01.explanation: Configures system password complexity and SHA-512 salt.

REM-TIMEOUT-01.objective: Set 10-minute administrative idle timeout on Junos
REM-TIMEOUT-01.cli_command:
set system login idle-timeout 10
commit comment "Set 10 min idle timeout"
REM-TIMEOUT-01.explanation: Enforces automatic disconnect after 10 minutes of CLI inactivity.

REM-CRYPTO-01.objective: Enforce strong ciphers and disable weak algorithms in Junos
REM-CRYPTO-01.cli_command:
set system services ssh ciphers [ aes256-gcm@openssh.com aes128-gcm@openssh.com aes256-ctr ]
commit comment "Disable weak ciphers"
REM-CRYPTO-01.after_example: set system services ssh ciphers [ aes256-gcm@openssh.com ... ]
REM-CRYPTO-01.rollback_command:
delete system services ssh ciphers
commit
REM-CRYPTO-01.explanation: Restricts SSH to AES-GCM and AES-CTR suites.

REM-UNUSED-01.objective: Disable auxiliary services (FTP, Finger) on Junos
REM-UNUSED-01.cli_command:
delete system services ftp
delete system services finger
delete system services rlogin
commit comment "Disable unused legacy services"

REM-MGMT-01.objective: Isolate management interface in dedicated management routing-instance on Junos
REM-MGMT-01.cli_command:
set routing-instances mgmt_junos description "Out of Band Management VRF"
set routing-instances mgmt_junos routing-options static route 0.0.0.0/0 next-hop 192.168.100.1
set interfaces fxp0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.100.2/24
commit comment "Isolate management plane"
REM-MGMT-01.before_example: set interfaces fxp0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.100.2/24
REM-MGMT-01.explanation: Places fxp0 management interface into dedicated routing table.

REM-ACL-01.objective: Bind stateless firewall filter with default discard term on Junos
REM-ACL-01.cli_command:
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term PERMIT-SSH from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term PERMIT-SSH from port 22
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term PERMIT-SSH then accept
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term DEFAULT-DISCARD then log
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term DEFAULT-DISCARD then discard
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet filter input PROTECT-RE
commit comment "Enforce Routing Engine firewall filter"
REM-ACL-01.before_example: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 10.255.255.1/32
REM-ACL-01.after_example: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet filter input PROTECT-RE
REM-ACL-01.verification_command: show configuration firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE
REM-ACL-01.rollback_command:
delete interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet filter input
commit
REM-ACL-01.explanation: Filters loopback control plane packets with explicit logging discard.

REM-FW-01.objective: Configure SRX security zones and stateful policies
REM-FW-01.cli_command:
set security zones security-zone TRUST interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 host-inbound-traffic system-services [ ssh ping ]
set security zones security-zone UNTRUST interfaces ge-0/0/1.0
set security policies from-zone TRUST to-zone UNTRUST policy ALLOW-WEB match source-address any destination-address any application [ junos-http junos-https ]
set security policies from-zone TRUST to-zone UNTRUST policy ALLOW-WEB then permit
commit comment "Configure stateful zone policy"
REM-FW-01.explanation: Instantiates stateful flow processing between Trust and Untrust zones.

REM-REMOTE-01.objective: Configure IKEv2 proposal with AES-256-GCM on Junos SRX
REM-REMOTE-01.cli_command:
set security ike proposal IKEV2-SEC-PROP authentication-method pre-shared-keys
set security ike proposal IKEV2-SEC-PROP dh-group group19
set security ike proposal IKEV2-SEC-PROP encryption-algorithm aes-256-gcm
set security ike proposal IKEV2-SEC-PROP lifetime-seconds 28800
commit comment "Enforce IKEv2 AES-256-GCM"
REM-REMOTE-01.before_example: set security ike proposal IKE-PROP encryption-algorithm 3des-cbc
REM-REMOTE-01.after_example: set security ike proposal IKEV2-SEC-PROP encryption-algorithm aes-256-gcm
REM-REMOTE-01.rollback_command:
delete security ike proposal IKEV2-SEC-PROP
commit
REM-REMOTE-01.explanation: Enforces modern elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman and GCM encryption.

REM-AUTH-01.objective: Configure login retry lockout threshold on Junos
REM-AUTH-01.cli_command:
set system login retry-options backoff-threshold 3
set system login retry-options backoff-factor 5
set system login retry-options tries-before-disconnect 4
commit comment "Enforce brute-force retry backoff"
REM-AUTH-01.explanation: Delays subsequent login attempts exponentially after 3 failed attempts.

REM-AUTHZ-01.objective: Configure granular login permission classes on Junos
REM-AUTHZ-01.cli_command:
set system login class SEC-OPERATOR permissions [ view network ]
set system login class SEC-OPERATOR allow-commands "show (interfaces|chassis|bgp)"
set system login class SEC-OPERATOR deny-commands "request|restart|test"
commit comment "Configure granular RBAC permissions"
REM-AUTHZ-01.before_example: set system login class OPERATOR permissions all
REM-AUTHZ-01.after_example: set system login class SEC-OPERATOR permissions [ view network ] ...
REM-AUTHZ-01.verification_command: show configuration system login class SEC-OPERATOR
REM-AUTHZ-01.rollback_command:
delete system login class SEC-OPERATOR
commit
REM-AUTHZ-01.explanation: Restricts operator class to read-only network inspection commands.

REM-ROUTING-01.objective: Configure MD5 neighbor authentication on BGP & OSPF in Junos
REM-ROUTING-01.cli_command:
set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL-PEERS authentication-key "$9$BGP_S3cur3!"
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/0.0 authentication md5 1 key "$9$OSPF_S3cur3!"
commit comment "Enforce routing protocol authentication"
REM-ROUTING-01.before_example: set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL-PEERS peer-as 65002
REM-ROUTING-01.after_example: set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL-PEERS authentication-key ...
REM-ROUTING-01.rollback_command:
delete protocols bgp group EXTERNAL-PEERS authentication-key
commit
REM-ROUTING-01.explanation: Applies cryptographic message authentication to dynamic routing packets.

REM-IFSEC-01.objective: Enable MAC limiting and BPDU block on access switchports in Junos
REM-IFSEC-01.cli_command:
set ethernet-switching-options secure-access-port interface ge-0/0/0.0 mac-limit 2
set ethernet-switching-options secure-access-port interface ge-0/0/0.0 action-on-overflow-packet drop-and-log
set protocols rstp interface ge-0/0/0.0 bpdu-block
commit comment "Enforce access port security and BPDU block"
REM-IFSEC-01.before_example: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family ethernet-switching
REM-IFSEC-01.after_example:
set ethernet-switching-options secure-access-port ...
set protocols rstp interface ge-0/0/0.0 bpdu-block
REM-IFSEC-01.explanation: Drops packets from unlearned MACs and blocks unexpected STP bridge protocol data units.
